layout_overrides_elimination.solution: Move these layout overrides to a separate CSS block scoped to the parent product page. Use higher specificity via ancestor selector cascade rather than !important, OR move to theme.css with proper theme editor compatibility. Since OCP forbids modifying theme.css, add these as un-scoped overrides in sticker-configurator.css with double-class selectors (e.g., .product-information.product-information) to beat inline styles.

SRP_Single_Responsibility.verification: Liquid → structure only. CSS → presentation only. JS → behavior only. No <style> in .liquid. No <script> in .liquid.

OCP_Open_Closed.verification: No modifications to core theme files (theme.js, theme.css, theme.liquid). Everything is self-contained in sections/ and assets/. The Web Component pattern means new features are added via subclassing or composition, not by editing the section file.

LSP_Liskov_Substitution.verification: All canvas items (images and text) are position:absolute divs with consistent .canvas-item class. Image items have child, text items have .text-content child. Both follow the same data model (item object). Any item can be substituted for any other in array operations.

ISP_Interface_Segregation.verification: All internal methods pass specific parameters, not global/god objects. E.g., startResize(e, id, handle) passes exactly what's needed. updateGuides(item, items) passes both. addTextItem takes explicit font params, not a config object. Modal callbacks provide specific data shapes.

DIP_Dependency_Inversion.verification: No direct DOM queries across component boundaries. The Web Component owns its own DOM subtree. Communication upward is via CustomEvent dispatch. No import/require of theme globals. jsPDF is loaded dynamically (no static dependency).
